agent_finalization: native tool loop, then one schema-constrained answer without tools; all turns share the case deadline and contribute to metrics
agent_scoring: tool-use success checks required calls, arguments, order and final state; exact final-answer success is reported separately; end-to-end requires both
memory_telemetry: Linux available-memory estimate; macOS free/compressed/wired memory and swap; all swap counters are system-wide, not model-specific

options.setup: Raspberry Pi 5 8 GB; Raspberry Pi OS Lite 64-bit, headless; official Raspberry Pi Active Cooler; clear vented acrylic case with lid; official Raspberry Pi 27 W USB-C power supply; SanDisk Extreme 128 GB microSDXC UHS-I; Ollama systemd service with LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM=0; 2 GB zram; room about 22 C (estimated)
